description: This file defines a Gantt chart component for rendering timeline entries as an SVG, including utility functions for formatting durations and tick labels, and the main GanttChart React component.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string with seconds or minutes.

methods.name: GanttChart
methods.description: React component that renders a Gantt chart SVG based on provided timeline entries.
